trigger: human merge of the exact Build 232 pull request followed by a successful exact-release staging deployment
approval_scope: verify only that Bennett field-production posting is blocked and contains no Day 1 or Day 2 records
future_human_record_requirements: verified labour hours by approved cost code
verified installed or completed production quantities
field narrative, conditions, safety and quality notes
multiple field photos from the actual work
multiple delivery, disposal, or other field tickets where applicable
permitted_actions: authenticate through the live HTTPS staging origin
read the exact awarded project, quote, estimate workspace, budget, procurement plan, safety launch, project workspace, launch dashboard, and daily-timesheet bootstrap
read exact database counts before and after verification
verify the fail-closed posting blockers and zero field-production state
upload immutable evidence retained for 90 days
prohibited_actions: fabricate Day 1 or Day 2 field facts
create, submit, approve, export, post, reopen, revise, or void a daily sheet
upload or create a field photo, ticket, generated daily report, time entry, safety record, or actual cost
prepare the Field_Production folder hierarchy before an approved production post
release safety, assign portal access, or complete a mobilization control
select a vendor, create a commitment, purchase order, invoice, or accounting export
create or claim an external Google Drive folder
issue or externally send any record
change DNS, certificates, secrets, backups, authentication, or infrastructure
